Use case: component assembly illustration. Create a clear two-panel upper-body assembly design sheet for the bomber component of Social Brave King, with one small motion inset. Ivory landscape canvas, restrained orange assembly arrows, exact clean KINETIC_CEL drawing. No text. Input 1 is the updated aircraft source, input 2 the approved combined appearance, input 3 the correct selected shoulder side shape, input 4 the complete core. Do not redesign the approved robot; this is a component installation study only.

LEFT LARGE PANEL: front three-quarter waist-up complete core drawn in quiet pale gray/low contrast, solid current orange/ivory/graphite aircraft parts floating a short distance around it in an understandable exploded assembly. Central orange blunt cockpit/nose piece stands upright just in FRONT OF THE CHEST, blue canopy above orange nose, not on the face or head. The central orange/graphite backpack part with stacked dark grilles and exactly TWO upright orange-edged fins is BEHIND THE UPPER BACK. A simple linking dark hinge/spine connects chest fuselage and back pack around the upper torso. Left and right MAIN WING/ENGINE CARRIERS are separate matching units at the shoulders: each consists of one broad swept graphite/ivory triangular wing and its one cylindrical underwing engine, matching input 1 and 2. Show a circular wing-root pivot and visible clearance gap at each junction between central fuselage and wing carrier; the core's own shoulder joint is BELOW and free. Short arrows guide central nose to chest, backpack to upper back, wing carriers to their roots; not a pile of duplicated airplanes.

RIGHT LARGE PANEL: the installed waist-up combination matching input 2 exactly in major shapes: blunt orange cockpit chest, long orange/ivory mane and upgraded silver crown, giant fists partly visible below, wide bomber main wings at shoulders, two correct forward intakes, two vertical fins behind head/shoulders. Use the thick sloping triangular shoulder/wing casing from input 3, not a tiny flat ornamental strip. Maintain circular root gaps between center and each carrier. No duplicate cockpit, third fin or additional engine.

SMALL LOWER INSET: a simple cropped near shoulder in two poses, arm relaxed then raised diagonally; show wing/engine carrier on its OWN root pivot lifting slightly to clear the core upper arm. Central chest body remains stationary. One modest curved arrow shows carrier motion. This is a broad legible toy/mecha articulation idea, not an exact collision or contact simulation. Do not add technical gibberish or a new mecha.
